summary: Iteration 18 production hotfix verified — engineer can list ALL projects, photos persist in GridFS bucket `site_visit_photos`, public no-auth photo serve endpoint streams correctly (with disk fallback), DELETE removes both disk + GridFS, PDFs (authed and public) embed GridFS-stored photos, photos survive backend restart. Frontend: Engineer's Linked Project picker now populated (verified 5+ projects with Job badges visible); SiteVisitDetailPage header shows 'SV-XXXX · Job NNNN' (verified on SV-0083/Job 0099 and SV-0089/Job 3325); admin sees 'Linked Project' financials card (project name link, code, job_no, client, OUTSTANDING pill, Quoted/Received/Outstanding tiles); engineer correctly hidden; photos on detail load (11 imgs, 0 broken on SV-0089); SiteVisitsPage shows Job NNNN under visit_code in both desktop table and mobile cards.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> child of <option> inside inspection-template <select>. Cosmetic React DOM-nesting warning, no visible breakage — likely from value-edit attribution helper wrapping option text. Suggest unwrapping the inner span.

action_items: Optional cleanup: remove the inner <span> wrapper around <option> text on SiteVisitFormPage line ~405 (React hydration warning, no functional impact).

Optional: when a visit's linked project_id resolves to 404 (project deleted/archived), backend currently returns 404 from /api/projects/<id> — UI correctly hides the financials card, but it would be cleaner to swallow the 404 and not log it as an error.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4797 lines — exceeds the 700-line soft limit; recommend splitting into routers (projects, site_visits, uploads, auth, audits, etc.) for maintainability.

_photo_to_image_reader (server.py:4043) does NOT use the pre-loaded `_raw_bytes` itself, but the sync renderer at line ~4625 falls back to `_raw_bytes` via ImageReader — works, but the two helpers should be unified to avoid future drift.
serve_site_visit_photo on auth_public_router is correct (img src can't send Bearer tokens). Verified no auth required and disk fallback in place.
GridFS bucket name `site_visit_photos` consistently used across upload/serve/delete — good.
Photo persistence verified across backend supervisor restart (file bytes survive).
seed_data_creation: Tests create + delete TEST_ prefixed uploads and one TEST_iter18_GridFS_PDF visit (cleaned up at fixture teardown). No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter18 production hotfixes verified — engineer-scope project filter removed, photos persist in GridFS bucket `site_visit_photos`, public no-auth photo URL streams from GridFS with disk fallback, DELETE wipes both, PDFs embed GridFS bytes via _preload_visit_photo_bytes, photos survive backend restarts. UI shows '· Job NNNN' in detail header and listing; admin gets Linked Project financials card while engineer doesn't. The only frontend nit is a React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> on SiteVisitFormPage (cosmetic). For future regressions run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration18_gridfs_photos_and_engineer_projects.py + iter17 file together.
rca of the issue: (1) Empty project picker for engineer: list_projects previously filtered by assigned_engineer_ids; fix removed the filter so engineers see all non-archived projects (verified: admin and engineer return identical project_id sets). (2) Photos broken on admin view: photos were stored only on local disk on the pod that handled the upload; when admin hit a different pod the file 404'd. Fix writes bytes into MongoDB GridFS (`site_visit_photos`) so every pod can serve them; serve route falls back to disk for legacy. (3) PDFs missing photos: sync ReportLab builder couldn't run async GridFS reads, so _preload_visit_photo_bytes now pre-loads bytes asynchronously into the photo dicts before rendering, and the renderer reads from `_raw_bytes`. Verified PDF size > 2KB and starts with %PDF.
